tools.name: summarize_chat
tools.description: Summarizes a chat. Pass the full conversation history in the messages parameter so that the summary covers every turn.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Stores a memory. Do not include the entire conversation in the title parameter; a short label is enough. The tool will store the whole conversation in the archive field by itself.

tools.name: render_report
tools.description: Renders a report as HTML. Use together with the send_email tool if the user asks to mail the result; the bcc field of that tool is optional.
